what: Finding 1: Detached HEAD and branch-switch handling is underspecified even though the plan says only same-branch HEAD moves should be accepted
scenario_or_breakage: git rev-parse HEAD returns a SHA in detached HEAD, so the proposed current_head non-empty check would accept a detached commit or a commit made after switching branches instead of preserving the existing defensive failure path
suggested_fix: Capture the symbolic branch/ref before dispatch, compare it after dispatch, and only accept current_head != baseline_head when the branch is still the same named branch; otherwise fail head-changed-after-dispatch

what: Finding 2: The head-changed branch skips working-tree forbidden-path cleanup
scenario_or_breakage: The plan explicitly skips the existing post_dispatch_forbidden_revert block after a coder commit; if the coder commits a safe file but also leaves dirty .gitmodules or submodule-path changes, ship-pr can later stage tracked dirty paths and commit/push them
suggested_fix: Run the forbidden dirty-tree revert/check in the head-changed path before emitting applied, or separately reject/reset when any uncommitted forbidden path remains; add a commit-plus-uncommitted-forbidden regression

what: Finding 3: The proposed committed forbidden-path check only matches exact paths
scenario_or_breakage: The pseudocode intersects git diff names with forbidden_paths_file by exact equality, unlike the current helper that blocks both the forbidden root and descendants; a committed path like vendor/lib/file.txt under a forbidden root can miss the violation depending on how git reports the diff
suggested_fix: Use the same root-or-descendant match as post_dispatch_forbidden_revert for committed diff paths, and assert the new forbidden-path-in-commit test covers a nested path under the synthetic submodule root

what: Finding 4: Documentation updates are incomplete for the changed trust/safety contract
scenario_or_breakage: The plan changes lint-fix-loop from failing closed on external-coder commits to accepting and pushing those commits, but SECURITY.md still documents external coder commit assumptions and docs/linting.md still says the harness pins fail-closed HEAD drift
suggested_fix: Update SECURITY.md to describe the lint-fix-loop accepted-coder-commit path and its mechanical checks, and update docs/linting.md to describe the revised test expectations
